phase_name: Add Check E to lint-agent-contracts.sh, with fixtures

objectives.description: Source the shared vocabulary library; implement check_e_terminal_metadata_presence with Detector A (presence) and Detector B (completed prohibition); wire into main() and --help
Re-verify the 13-entry exclusion-list scope hypothesis live against the real source store; determine the correct final exclusion set
Repair compliant-agent.md/check-f-conforming-agent.md fixtures and shared ARTIFACTS_TEMPLATE_BLOCK; add 6 new Check E fixtures and assertions; add status-lib copy to both scratch trees

approaches_tried.approach: Seed EXCLUDED_TERMINAL_STATUS_RELATIVE_PATHS with the plan's hypothesized 13-entry list (7 filetypes/* agents, present/{pptx,slidev}-assembly-agent, founder/legal-analysis-agent, plus the 2 Check F exclusions), using short (unprefixed) relative paths matching Check C's IN_SCOPE_RELATIVE_PATHS convention
approaches_tried.reason: Two independent bugs: (1) rel_path() output carries the agent-system/extensions/ prefix (matching Check F's convention, not Check C's), so unprefixed paths never matched and 5 genuinely-excludable files FAILed instead of being skipped; (2) live verification showed the 7 filetypes/* agents and legal-analysis-agent all carry a genuine failed/partial canonical status for their error path, so they pass Detector A on their own merit and do not belong on the exclusion list at all -- the plan's 13-entry hypothesis was wrong on both counts. Final list: 5 entries, full agent-system/extensions/-prefixed paths.

deviations.description: Seed the exclusion list with the plan's hypothesized 13 entries
deviations.reason: Live verification against the real source store (explicitly required by the plan's own Scope Hypothesis note) showed only 5 of the 13 hypothesized entries are genuinely unfixable; the other 8 already pass Check E's presence detector via a legitimate failed/partial branch and would have been wrongly excluded
